pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped multi-sided polygons with sharp, angular vertices and jagged edge gradients. Patch spatial area is larger on the central flank and becomes more condensed and smaller towards the shoulder and posterior region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected grid of light cream-colored negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, exhibiting a consistent sawtooth-like geometric contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized increase in pigment saturation within patches along the dorsal midline, creating a darker longitudinal band relative to the lateral flank.
